article.title: Don’t pretend the ‘War on Drugs’ has anything to do with fighting drugs
article.author: Editor
article.content: Addressing the UN General Assembly in September, Donald Trump gloated about his strategy toward “narcoterrorist” cartels, the menace du jour in the United States’ self-declared backyard.
